acceptanceCriteria: start accepts explicit source references and automatically records preflight plus exactly one before_edit checkpoint when preflight is green; red or needs_human_confirmation is durably reported and creates no checkpoint
verify performs cheap Contract, scope, snapshot, lifecycle, and plan checks before any project verification process and emits a structured reason with zero spawned processes when blocked
plan-only and normal verify expose the same deterministic per-node action, state, reuse or rerun reason, and identity binding; protected checks never reuse without explicit policy
normal verify executes only planned nodes, persists execution attempts before formal evidence promotion, and updates authoritative Summary/evidence through Runtime without manual projection edits
CLI and MCP invoke equivalent lifecycle/verification semantics; tests cover green, human-review, precondition failure, fresh reuse, stale rerun, and receipt-promotion failure
goal: A single start operation records a valid preflight and before-edit checkpoint when no human review is required; verify performs cheap checks before child processes and reports identity-bound per-node reuse, rerun, or blocked decisions, then persists attempts and formal evidence without agent-managed Summary or receipt steps.
intent: Reduce manual lifecycle coordination while preserving explicit human authority by making the Runtime own preflight, checkpoint, verification planning, result persistence, and Summary projection.
outOfScope: Changing human authorization or accepting needs_human_confirmation automatically

scenarioCoverage.expected: start records current preflight and one checkpoint without separate agent lifecycle commands
scenarioCoverage.scenario: green start automatically persists preflight and exactly one before_edit checkpoint

scenarioCoverage.expected: structured needs_human_confirmation is retained and checkpoint count remains zero
scenarioCoverage.scenario: human confirmation during start preserves the review boundary and creates no checkpoint

scenarioCoverage.expected: a structured blocked attempt is persisted before any expensive project command starts
scenarioCoverage.scenario: blocked cheap verification precondition starts zero project child processes
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: focused verification precondition test with process counter

scenarioCoverage.expected: both paths expose deterministic actions, states, reasons, and input identities
scenarioCoverage.scenario: plan-only and execution report the same identity-bound per-node reuse and rerun decisions
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: focused reusable-attempt and stale-identity integration tests

scenarioCoverage.expected: attempt exit status, timeout, duration, logs, and input identity survive formal receipt rejection
scenarioCoverage.scenario: failed verification attempt remains available when formal evidence promotion fails
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: focused attempt persistence and receipt promotion failure test

scenarioCoverage.expected: both interfaces preserve the same green, review-required, blocked, reuse, stale, and receipt-failure outcomes
scenarioCoverage.scenario: CLI and MCP use equivalent automatic lifecycle and verification planning semantics

sources: User authorization in the current task: Runtime should automatically maintain preflight, checkpoint, Summary, and receipt state; verification must identify reusable and rerun results before expensive execution.
crates/cockpit-cli/src/main.rs: current verify --plan-only returns before identity-bound reusable-attempt lookup.
crates/cockpit-repository/src/lifecycle.rs: existing verification-attempt persistence and identity-bound reuse implementation.
crates/cockpit-verification/src/lib.rs: existing per-node verification action, state, and reason model.
Observed plan-only and immediately-following execution decisions differ; the shared verification planner must identify which bound context fields make a cached result stale.
